description: Provenance and migration-ownership ledger for every tracked haxe.go std, support, runtime-binding, and public native-facade source.

ownershipClasses.upstream_std_override: Target-specific implementation of an upstream Haxe std module that must package as .cross.hx.
ownershipClasses.staged_support: Repo-authored Haxe support used by an override but not itself an upstream module; it stays an ordinary .hx module.
ownershipClasses.hxrt_binding: Typed Haxe extern or carrier binding for a real runtime/hxrt Go API; it stays outside the override-only tree.
ownershipClasses.public_go_facade: Public typed go.* native facade; it remains importable under std/go and never enters _std.
ownershipClasses.obsolete: Tracked source proven unnecessary; removal requires a named migration bead and evidence.
ownershipClasses.intentional_boundary_fixture: Deliberate policy fixture retained only to exercise a target boundary; it requires a named migration bead.

Canonical staged Date API over a portable epoch-millisecond carrier. Haxe owns constructors and public policy; typed NativeDate delegates only host clock, timezone, parsing, formatting, and calendar conversion to footprint-explicit runtime support.
Go staged portable override for DateTools helper ownership, keeping formatting and date-helper semantics out of GoCompiler.

Canonical staged EReg API. Haxe owns options, match state, capture validation, split/map traversal, matchSub, and global replacement policy; the typed NativeRegex boundary exposes only compiled RE2 execution and code-point-normalized match snapshots.

Canonical staged implementation of all 19 Lambda algorithms over Haxe Iterable, with exact source-call representation adapters registered separately for Go slices, lists, concrete iterator classes, typed callbacks, constrained nested carriers, and erased results; full carrier closure completed by haxe_go-vfp.8.7.18.

Canonical staged Math API. Haxe owns rounding, finiteness, NaN propagation, and operand-order signed-zero policy; typed externs call Go math and math/rand directly, with three narrow hxrt Int-returning rounders for the native signature mismatch.

Canonical staged Haxe 4.3.7 Reflect API. Haxe source owns public lookup precedence, property policy, copying, deletion, and varargs composition; a typed footprint-explicit hxrt boundary handles ordinary Go representation inspection, while exact same-package compiler metadata adapters expose only closed generated fields, methods, RTTI, and enum carriers.

Canonical staged complete Haxe 4.3.7 Std API. Haxe source owns parseInt/parseFloat scanning and overflow policy, aliases, downcast policy, truncation bounds, and random guards. Typed bindings retain only exact native float conversion, integer truncation, and random generation; Std.string and Std.isOfType remain separately registered representation intrinsics.

Canonical source-owned implementation of the supported Haxe 4.3.7 root Sys API; map construction, fallbacks, aliases, standard-stream wrapping, getChar EOF construction, and explicit echo stay in Haxe while typed std/hxrt bindings expose native process, display, file, and terminal capabilities.

Canonical staged UnicodeString API. Haxe owns code-point bounds, slicing, searching, comparison, iteration, operators, and UTF-8 validation; typed GoStringRuntime calls expose only rune length, code-point lookup, and already-normalized slicing over the pointer-backed Go string representation.

Canonical staged root Xml DOM. It preserves the upstream API and algorithms while replacing only Go-incompatible inline throwing accessors, invariant concrete iterators, unsupported array remove/insert calls, and an empty firstChild bounds edge with source-level equivalents.

Go staged portable override for haxe.Constraints constraint aliases plus named erased IMap bridge methods, keeping Haxe-facing typing in source while generated Go interfaces preserve exact method signatures.

Canonical staged Haxe 4.3.7 Log formatting and trace policy. Source owns PosInfos/custom-parameter formatting, the mutable trace function, and Sys.println delegation; general typed class lowering owns static dynamic-function storage and catchable null invocation without a Log-specific rewrite.
Go staged target-sensitive override for haxe.CallStack, providing deterministic empty-stack fallbacks by default plus opt-in native stack diagnostics.

Go staged portable override for haxe.Template execution semantics. Template parsing, lookup, concrete and structural iteration, macro policy, and rendering remain in Haxe. haxe_go-vfp.8.7.16 moved its three runtime representation operations to a typed hxrt binding; haxe_go-vfp.8.7.19 lets the generic Reflect path consume selective already-bound generated-method metadata without restoring a Template compiler shim.
Staged upstream Printer algorithm with equivalent source-level newline removal for comments, avoiding an otherwise unnecessary dependency on the still-migrating compiler regex/serializer group.

Canonical staged Compress API. Haxe owns level validation, Bytes conversion, offsets, bounded public result construction, flush/lifecycle policy, and static run. haxe_go-vfp.8.7.21 added progressive execution over an opaque typed deflate handle; only native zlib state and execution cross the NativeZip boundary.

Canonical staged Uncompress API. Haxe owns the optional buffer default, Bytes conversion, offsets, bounded public result construction, flush/lifecycle policy, static run, and negative-window raw-DEFLATE selection. haxe_go-vfp.8.7.21 added progressive execution over an opaque typed inflate handle.
Canonical staged implementation of the body-less upstream haxe.atomic.AtomicInt core type over an opaque typed hxrt handle; native atomic memory operations remain runtime-owned.
Canonical staged implementation of the body-less upstream haxe.atomic.AtomicObject core type over an opaque typed hxrt handle; synchronization and reference comparison remain runtime-owned.

Staged Base64 API, alphabet, padding defaults, and Bytes conversion. Only raw codec execution crosses the typed NativeCrypto runtime boundary because upstream BaseCode currently depends on array-growth semantics unavailable to generated Go slices.
Staged MD5 public API and Bytes conversion over a typed native digest capability, replacing compiler-emitted library functions.
Staged SHA-1 public API and Bytes conversion over a typed native digest capability, replacing compiler-emitted library functions.
Staged SHA-224 public API and Bytes conversion over a typed native digest capability, replacing compiler-emitted library functions.
Staged SHA-256 public API and Bytes conversion over a typed native digest capability, replacing compiler-emitted library functions.

Canonical staged base for the portable haxe.http callback and payload API. Source-owned sys.Http now extends it directly, including mutable dynamic callback fields, with no compiler-emitted HTTP carrier.
Go staged portable override bundle for haxe.rtti.CType typedefs, enums, TypeApi, and CTypeTools, keeping public RTTI type logic out of GoCompiler.
Go staged portable override for haxe.rtti.Meta, routing public metadata access through the backend-owned class-token __meta__ contract.
Go staged portable override for haxe.rtti.Rtti, routing public RTTI lookup through the backend-owned class-token __rtti contract.
Go staged portable override for haxe.rtti.XmlParser, keeping parser logic in std while relying on the backend-owned anonymous-record mutation and RTTI metadata contracts underneath.
Go staged portable override for direct haxe.exceptions.PosException construction/toString ownership, keeping subclass parity out of GoCompiler.
Go staged portable override for direct haxe.exceptions.ArgumentException constructor/message ownership.
Go staged portable override for direct haxe.exceptions.NotImplementedException default-message ownership.
Go staged target-sensitive override for haxe.NativeStackTrace, exposing deterministic empty-stack behavior by default plus opt-in native stack diagnostics without claiming portable stack parity.
Go staged portable override for direct haxe.EntryPoint, connecting runInMainThread/addThread/run to the runtime-backed sys.thread.EventLoop main-thread loop.
Go staged portable override for direct haxe.MainLoop/MainEvent, preserving the Haxe-facing event facade while scheduling callbacks through haxe.EntryPoint and sys.thread.EventLoop.
Go staged portable override for direct haxe.Timer, registering timers on Thread.current().events and using the hxrt monotonic thread clock for Timer.stamp().
Go staged portable override for direct haxe.ds.BalancedTree runtime ownership, keeping source-owned collection logic out of GoCompiler while preserving ordered map semantics.
Go staged portable override for direct haxe.ds.GenericStack runtime ownership, including localized erased-generic equality recovery.
Canonical staged BufferInput override; buffering, refill progress, and inherited stream behavior are ordinary Haxe source.
Canonical staged Bytes override over BytesData plus an opaque cached ByteView. Haxe owns bounds, alias observation, invalidation, encoding policy, and byte algorithms.
Canonical staged BytesBuffer override; public append and materialization policy no longer crosses a compiler shim.
Canonical staged BytesInput override with normal source inheritance, positions, bounds, EOF, and zero-copy input slicing policy.
Canonical staged BytesOutput override with normal source inheritance and Haxe-owned write, growth, and result semantics.
Canonical staged Encoding override; UTF8 and RawNative selection is source policy rather than a generated compiler carrier.
Canonical staged EOF exception and text contract, emitted through ordinary class and exception lowering.
Canonical staged haxe.io.Error constructors and payload semantics; no compiler-owned enum carrier remains.
Canonical staged Input base class; all stream loops, endian reads, EOF handling, and subclass dispatch are ordinary Haxe source.
Canonical staged Output base class; write loops, endian policy, overflow checks, and subclass dispatch are ordinary Haxe source.
Canonical staged StringInput override composed from staged BytesInput and Bytes.

Narrow same-package extern contract for compiler-owned closed-world Reflect metadata. It deliberately carries Dynamic only at the public reflection boundary and resolves to typed generated-package adapters rather than importing hxrt or creating a runtime registry.
Staged FPHelper owns Haxe word ordering and Int64 construction over the typed NativeFloatBits IEEE-754 reinterpretation capability; it has no compiler-shim dependency.

Go staged portable override for haxe.io.ArrayBufferView and the shared typed-array carrier API, keeping public typed-array behavior in std while the backend continues to own the underlying Bytes/ArrayBufferViewImpl representation.
Go staged portable override for haxe.io.UInt8Array, keeping the public typed-array API in std on top of the existing ArrayBufferViewImpl carrier.
Go staged portable override for haxe.io.UInt16Array, keeping the public typed-array API in std on top of the existing ArrayBufferViewImpl carrier.
Go staged portable override for haxe.io.UInt32Array, keeping the public typed-array API in std on top of the existing ArrayBufferViewImpl carrier.
Go staged portable override for haxe.io.Int32Array, keeping the public typed-array API in std on top of the existing ArrayBufferViewImpl carrier.
Go staged portable override for haxe.io.Float32Array, reusing staged FPHelper bit-conversion helpers instead of expanding compiler-owned Bytes float logic.
Go staged portable override for haxe.io.Float64Array, reusing staged FPHelper bit-conversion helpers instead of expanding compiler-owned Bytes double logic.
Canonical source-owned Haxe 4.3.7 sys.Http API. Request selection, payload assembly, public headers, callback order, and status/error policy stay in staged Haxe over typed native transport handles.

Ordinary staged support that implements source-owned haxe.io.Input and Output wrappers over a typed socket handle; byte bounds, EOF, blocked translation, and portable Bytes mutation stay outside compiler and runtime ownership.
Canonical source-owned implementation of the complete Haxe 4.3.7 sys.FileSystem API; public record construction stays in Haxe while typed std/hxrt bindings expose native filesystem capabilities.

Canonical source-owned implementation of the complete Haxe 4.3.7 sys.io.File static API; byte conversion and stream construction stay in Haxe while typed std/hxrt capabilities own native file operations.
Canonical source-owned Haxe 4.3.7 FileInput stream over an opaque typed hxrt handle; bounds checks, EOF translation, and seek-origin selection no longer live in GoCompiler.
Canonical source-owned Haxe 4.3.7 FileOutput stream over an opaque typed hxrt handle; bounds checks, byte conversion, and seek-origin selection no longer live in GoCompiler.
Canonical source-owned Haxe 4.3.7 seek-origin enum used by staged file streams instead of a compiler-synthesized carrier.

Canonical source-owned implementation of the complete Haxe 4.3.7 sys.io.Process API; public streams, bounds and EOF translation, nullable exit status, detached rejection, and closed-state policy stay in Haxe over typed hxrt process capabilities.
Go staged portable override for sys.net.Address, keeping the public {host, port} carrier and IPv4 helper methods in std while source-owned sockets translate typed native address carriers.
Canonical source-owned Haxe 4.3.7 sys.net.Host API over typed hxrt DNS and hostname capabilities; host identity, rendering, and public fields no longer come from compiler-synthesized declarations.
Canonical source-owned Haxe 4.3.7 sys.net.Socket API over one opaque typed hxrt handle; lifecycle, stream wrappers, exceptions, select identity, and public address construction stay in staged Haxe.
Canonical source-owned Haxe 4.3.7 sys.net.UdpSocket API; byte bounds and public Address mutation remain Haxe policy while typed hxrt capabilities own native datagram transport and broadcast options.
Go staged portable override for the public sys.ssl.Certificate API, keeping certificate-facing methods in std while runtime/hxrt/ssl.go owns parsing and trust-root behavior.
Go staged portable override for the public sys.ssl.Digest API, keeping the Haxe-facing helpers in std while runtime/hxrt/ssl.go owns the cryptographic implementation.
Go staged portable override for sys.ssl.DigestAlgorithm enum/abstract ownership, keeping the public algorithm surface out of compiler shims.
Go staged portable override for the public sys.ssl.Key API, keeping Haxe-facing key helpers in std while runtime/hxrt/ssl.go owns PEM parsing and native key handling.

Canonical source-owned Haxe 4.3.7 sys.ssl.Socket API composed over the staged sys.net.Socket and shared typed handle. TLS transport capabilities live in footprint-explicit socket_ssl.go; configuration, accepted-object identity, and certificate wrapping remain staged source.
Go staged portable override for sys.thread.Condition, keeping the public wait/signal API in std while runtime/hxrt/thread.go owns the native condition state and timeout behavior.
Go staged portable override for sys.thread.Deque, keeping the Haxe-facing queue API in std while runtime/hxrt/thread.go owns the synchronized queue carrier and blocking semantics.
Go staged portable override for the sys.thread.IThreadPool contract, keeping the public pool interface in std while concrete pool scheduling stays in staged implementations.
Go staged portable override for sys.thread.Lock, keeping the Haxe-facing lock API in std while runtime/hxrt/thread.go owns the native lock state and wait semantics.
Go staged portable override for sys.thread.Mutex, keeping the public mutex API in std while runtime/hxrt/thread.go owns the native mutex carrier.
Go staged portable override for sys.thread.NoEventLoopException, keeping the public exception surface in std while Thread/EventLoop runtime ownership lives under runtime/hxrt/thread.go.
Go staged portable override for sys.thread.Semaphore, keeping the public semaphore API in std while runtime/hxrt/thread.go owns token accounting and timeout behavior.
Go staged portable override for sys.thread.ThreadPoolException, keeping the public exception surface for thread pools in std.
Go staged portable override for sys.thread.Tls, keeping the Haxe-facing thread-local API in std while runtime/hxrt/thread.go owns logical thread identity and per-thread storage.
Go staged portable override for sys.thread.EventLoop, keeping the public loop API and enum surface in std while runtime/hxrt/thread.go owns the queue/timer handle state.

Go staged portable override for sys.thread.Thread, keeping the public Haxe-facing thread/message API in std while runtime/hxrt/thread.go owns logical thread identity, queues, and per-thread loop handles.
Go staged portable override for sys.thread.ElasticThreadPool, keeping worker-pool policy in Haxe code once Thread/Lock/Deque are runtime-backed.
Go repo-authored helper worker type for sys.thread.ElasticThreadPool, split into its own file so staged std emission stays explicit and import-safe.
Go staged portable override for sys.thread.FixedThreadPool, keeping fixed-worker scheduling policy in Haxe code instead of compiler-owned shims.
Go repo-authored helper worker type for sys.thread.FixedThreadPool, split into its own file so staged std emission stays explicit and import-safe.
Go repo-authored private shutdown sentinel for sys.thread.FixedThreadPool worker termination semantics.
Go staged portable override for direct haxe.SysTools quoting helpers, keeping command-line quoting semantics out of GoCompiler while upstream string/array lowerings remain incomplete.

Canonical staged Haxe 4.3.7 serializer token stream, caches, traversal, collection handling, and custom-hook policy. Field enumeration, reads, and hook invocation reuse staged Reflect over typed same-package generated metadata; no serializer-specific bridge or unsafe runtime field access remains.

Canonical staged Haxe 4.3.7 unserializer parser, resolver policy, cache ordering, token construction, and custom-hook dispatch. Assignment and calls reuse staged Reflect; Type metadata constructs empty instances with typed inherited carriers and valid virtual-dispatch self bindings.
Go staged portable override for deprecated haxe.Utf8 helper ownership, keeping legacy UTF-8 buffer and encode/decode semantics out of GoCompiler while upstream lowerings remain incomplete.
Go staged portable override for StringTools helper ownership, keeping basic string helpers out of GoCompiler.
Go staged portable override for haxe.Json, delegating behavior to hxrt runtime helpers.

Go staged portable override for haxe.ds.HashMap entrypoint behavior and owned iterator surfaces, including direct lowercase hashCode parity without target-specific aliases.
Source-owned haxe.ds.IntMap API and algorithms over a narrow typed hxrt integer-keyed storage handle with deterministic key snapshots.
Source-owned haxe.ds.List API and algorithms over a private array carrier; Lambda and serializer integration use only public iterator and API methods after haxe_go-vfp.8.7.17.
Source-owned haxe.ds.ObjectMap API and algorithms over a narrow typed hxrt identity-storage handle that retains keys and deterministic insertion order.
Source-owned haxe.ds.StringMap API and algorithms over a narrow typed hxrt string-keyed storage handle with deterministic key snapshots.

Go staged portable override for haxe.format.JsonPrinter, delegating print path to haxe.Json.
Go staged portable override for DynamicAccess key/value iterator semantics.

Go staged portable override for Unicode-aware string key/value iterator semantics.

Opaque typed extern carrier for one runtime/hxrt atomic object cell; staged haxe.atomic.AtomicObject owns the public API.

Typed-handle extern bridge from staged haxe.atomic.AtomicObject to the narrow runtime/hxrt object atomic capability surface; Dynamic is localized to erased stored values.
Opaque typed extern carrier for one runtime/hxrt integer-keyed map cell; staged haxe.ds.IntMap owns the public collection contract.
Narrow typed extern predicate for recognizing generated enum carriers; EnumValueMap comparison and balancing remain in staged Haxe.

Typed-handle extern bridge from staged haxe.ds.ObjectMap to native reference-identity storage; erased keys and values are localized to this generic boundary.
Typed extern bridge from staged haxe.ds.StringMap to native string-keyed storage and deterministic key snapshots.

Opaque typed extern carrier for one runtime/hxrt string-keyed map cell; staged haxe.ds.StringMap owns the public collection contract.
Opaque typed carrier for one native HTTP request builder; it exposes no generated sys.Http layout or callback policy.
Opaque typed owner for one live native response body, transport, cancellation context, and optional socket; staged sys.Http owns bounded reads and public lifecycle choreography.
Opaque typed carrier for one bounded response chunk plus its same-call EOF or error state, so staged sys.Http never loses partial progress.

Opaque typed carrier for a caller-driven, cancellation-aware native multipart upload sink. Staged sys.Http reads the Haxe Input on its source caller and writes immutable chunks through this boundary; the Go transport never calls generated Haxe.

Typed footprint-explicit bridge to Go URL parsing and HTTP transport. Only scalars, opaque byte views, typed request/exchange/upload handles, and typed socket handles cross the boundary; generated Haxe callbacks never cross into transport goroutines.
Opaque typed carrier for an immutable native byte view cached by staged haxe.io.Bytes; it exposes no generated Bytes layout or public policy.
Typed bridge for native byte allocation, opaque view conversion, overlap-safe copy, and UTF codec capabilities; staged Bytes retains validation, alias, cache, and encoding policy.
Typed scalar bridge to Go IEEE-754 bit reinterpretation; staged FPHelper retains Haxe word ordering and Int64 policy without recursive stream conversion.

Typed footprint-explicit bridge from staged haxe.crypto APIs to runtime/hxrt/crypto.go. It accepts only strings and opaque ByteView handles; public padding and API policy remain Haxe-owned while repeated integer/native-byte copies are avoided.
Typed scalar carrier for one local or UTC calendar decomposition; Go time.Time never enters the application-generated Date layout.
Typed footprint-explicit bridge from staged Date to runtime/hxrt/date.go using only scalar components, epoch milliseconds, strings, and DateParts.
Typed direct extern mapping for Float-returning Go math functions and IEEE-754 constructors; Haxe-specific policy remains in staged Math.
Typed bridge to the three footprint-explicit hxrt rounding functions needed only because Go math returns float64 while Haxe floor, ceil, and round return Int.
Typed direct extern mapping from staged Math.random to math/rand.Float64; no compiler rule or Go runtime wrapper is involved.

Typed footprint-explicit bridge from staged haxe.zip APIs to runtime/hxrt/zip.go. Integer byte arrays, scalar policy values, opaque codec handles, and a typed step carrier cross the package boundary; generated haxe.io.Bytes layouts never do.
Typed carrier for one bounded codec step. Native values, source progress, and completion cross into staged Haxe, which owns Bytes writes and the public anonymous result.
Opaque typed carrier for persistent Go zlib writer state used by staged haxe.zip.Compress; no native fields or generated Haxe layouts are exposed.
Opaque typed carrier for persistent Go zlib or raw-DEFLATE reader state and its fragment feeder; staged haxe.zip.Uncompress retains public lifecycle and buffer policy.

Opaque typed extern carrier for one runtime/hxrt readable file handle; staged sys.io.FileInput owns the public stream contract.
Opaque typed extern carrier for one runtime/hxrt writable file handle and its native ownership/flush policy; staged sys.io.FileOutput owns the public stream contract.

Typed extern bridge to the narrow runtime/hxrt filesystem capability surface used by canonical staged sys.FileSystem source.

Typed accepted-handle and readiness-status carrier translated into a source-owned sys.net.Socket by staged Haxe.
Typed native IPv4 and port carrier that staged source converts into the unchanged public Host and Address objects.
Typed UDP payload-progress, status, and peer-address carrier that avoids Dynamic and runtime-created Haxe objects.
Opaque typed extern carrier for a native TCP or UDP resource, its synchronized lifecycle, stream state, deadline, and socket-option policy.
Typed byte-progress and EOF/blocked status carrier consumed by ordinary staged socket stream wrappers.
Typed readiness-index slices that let staged Socket.select preserve exact public Socket identity and custom payload values.
Typed extern bridge to the narrow runtime/hxrt child-process and pipe capability surface used by canonical staged sys.io.Process source.
Typed exit-code availability carrier that lets staged sys.io.Process implement Null<Int> without Dynamic or Any at the native boundary.
Opaque typed extern carrier for one native child process owned by staged sys.io.Process.
Opaque typed extern carrier for a child stdin pipe wrapped by the staged haxe.io.Output implementation.
Opaque typed extern carrier for a child stdout or stderr pipe wrapped by the staged haxe.io.Input implementation.
Typed extern bridge to runtime/hxrt/regex.go for RE2 compilation, matching, and quoting; staged EReg owns every public semantic and state transition, including Haxe replacement-template expansion.
Opaque typed carrier for one compiled Go regexp resource retained privately by staged EReg.
Typed native match carrier whose indexes are normalized from Go UTF-8 byte offsets to the Haxe code-point string contract before staged EReg consumes them.

Typed extern bridge to footprint-explicit runtime/hxrt/reflect.go for ordinary map, exported struct-field, exported method, call, compare, object, copy, delete, and varargs operations. It carries no generated-program metadata or public lookup-order policy.
Typed found/value carrier that preserves the distinction between a missing dynamic field and a present field whose value is null across the staged Reflect runtime boundary.
Typed extern bridge only to bounded host float parsing. Generated field access and hidden-self initialization moved to existing typed same-package metadata under haxe_go-vfp.10.5.1.
Opaque typed extern carrier for parsed certificate chains and trust pools shared by staged certificate and TLS socket APIs.
Opaque typed extern carrier for parsed native public and private keys used by staged key, digest, and TLS APIs.
Typed extern bridge for certificate parsing, chain traversal, fields, dates, trust pools, and native alternate-name slices; staged Certificate owns public object and Array construction.
Typed hashing, signing, and verification bridge over explicit integer byte slices and opaque key handles.
Typed native key parsing bridge that keeps PEM/DER conversion in staged source and implementation-specific key values opaque.
Typed TLS composition bridge over the shared SocketHandle, opaque key/certificate/SNI values, and footprint-explicit runtime/hxrt/socket_ssl.go capabilities.
Opaque typed extern carrier for the TLS server's SNI matcher and certificate table, with public configuration retained by staged sys.ssl.Socket.
Typed extern bridge for the two Dynamic display signatures required by staged Sys.print and Sys.println, isolated on the baseline hxrt print slice.
Typed extern bridge to the narrow runtime/hxrt process-state, environment, clock, command, and path capabilities used by canonical staged root Sys source.
Typed footprint-explicit bridge to build-tagged runtime/hxrt terminal state and one-byte input; staged Sys retains EOF and echo semantics.
Typed extern carrier for one runtime/hxrt environment entry, allowing staged root Sys to construct the public StringMap without Dynamic or generated-map coupling.

Go typed extern bridge for the runtime/hxrt/stack.go frame carrier used by the explicit reflaxe_go_native_stack_trace diagnostic capability.

It performs no generated-method discovery; all Template lookup, concrete and structural iteration, macro, error, and rendering policy remains in Haxe source.
Go typed extern bridge under std/hxrt for the runtime/hxrt/thread.go condition carrier, allowing staged sys.thread overrides to call into the runtime without compiler-owned shims.
Go typed extern bridge under std/hxrt for the runtime/hxrt/thread.go event-loop handle, keeping sys.thread.EventLoop source-owned while the runtime owns queue and timer state.
Go typed extern bridge for the runtime/hxrt/thread.go event-loop progress carrier used by the staged sys.thread.EventLoop override.
